checks.mismatch: Amount differs from what is due
checks.mismatchOther: Amount matches — the time or receiving account does not; check the slip

home.title: Finance overview
home.description: The queues of every finance desk you work, with counts and SLA. Every number drills down to its source document.
home.noQueuesTitle: No finance queues for your role
home.noQueuesBody: You can still open the reports and documents your role allows from the side menu.
home.approvalsNote: A requester can never approve their own request (segregation of duties).
home.noApprovals: No finance requests are waiting for you

slips.title: Slip review
slips.description: Transfer slips the automatic check could not pass. Finance reviews each within 4 business hours, earliest deadline first.
slips.emptyBody: Slips that pass the automatic check confirm the payment without waiting for Finance.

review.title: Review slip {code}
review.description: Compare the slip with the amount due, then approve with the bank's transaction reference or reject with a reason.
review.bankTransRefHint: From the incoming line on the bank account; used to catch duplicate slips.
review.receivedAmountHint: Leave empty if the slip's amount was received.
review.rejectNote: Reason for rejecting (the customer sees it)
review.badAmount: Enter the amount as a number
review.needNote: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
review.readOnly: You can see the slip; approving it is Finance's job.
review.confirmApproveTitle: Approve the slip and take the payment
review.confirmApproveBody: Take {amount} for {code}, bank reference {reference}. The tax invoice / receipt is issued and posted (P02) straight away.
review.confirmRejectBody: The slip for {code} will not count as payment; the customer is asked for a new one.
review.imageUnavailable: The slip cannot be shown here

payments.title: Payments
payments.description: Every payment the books have recorded: gateways, slips, credit-term transfers and store credit.
payments.search: Search by reference, order or order group

refunds.title: Customer refunds
refunds.description: Every refund is approved by a Finance Manager other than the requester; a bank-transfer refund is then recorded by another Finance user with its reference.

request.title: Request a refund of {reference}
request.description: Give the amount, channel and reason; the request waits for a Finance Manager.
request.makerChecker: Whoever requests a refund can neither approve it nor record its payout.
request.amountHint: The API checks it is within what can be refunded.
request.needAmount: Enter the amount as a number, e.g. 350 or 350.50
request.needReason: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
request.confirmBody: Refund {amount} of payment {reference}. The request waits for a Finance Manager's approval.
request.sent: Refund requested — waiting for a Finance Manager

detail.title: Refund request
detail.waiting: Waiting for a Finance Manager's approval
detail.notYoursBody: Another Finance user records the transfer (segregation of duties).
detail.referenceHint: The reference the bank gave the outgoing transfer.
detail.confirmBody: Confirm {amount} was transferred back, reference {reference}. The refund is posted (P22) straight away.

documents.title: Customer document registers
documents.description: Issued by Collective Group (Thailand) under the Packio brand. Numbers run without gaps in each series; a voided document keeps its number and its reason.
documents.search: Search by number, order, buyer or tax id

detail.title: Customer document
detail.voided: This document was voided (its number is kept)
detail.links: Where it comes from and goes
detail.journalsNote: Every line opens its journal, posting rule, event and the people who made and checked it.
detail.voidBody: Void {number} for {amount}. The number is kept with the reason and its journals are reversed.

resend.title: Send {number} to the customer again
resend.description: Sends the same PDF; no new document is issued.
resend.how: It goes by the customer's own channels: e-mail, and LINE when they have linked it. The log on the document shows where it went.

debit.title: Issue a debit note against {number}
debit.description: A debit note adds to what the customer owes. VAT is charged at the original tax invoice's rate.
debit.netHint: VAT is worked out for you.
debit.needNet: Enter the amount as a number
debit.needNote: Give details of at least 3 characters
debit.confirmBody: Add {amount} net against {number}. It takes the next number in the debit note series.
debit.failed: Could not issue the debit note

creditNotes.title: Credit notes
creditNotes.description: Credit notes requested and what became of them. A credit note is numbered and posted only once a Finance Manager other than the requester approves it.
creditNotes.search: Search by order code or details

wizard.title: Request a credit note
wizard.description: A credit note always refers to a tax invoice and uses a reason from the statutory list.
wizard.searchHint: Type a document number, order code or buyer name (at least 2 characters).
wizard.kindHint: Each kind maps to its statutory reason.

kindHints.shortage: Short, but within the agreed tolerance
kindHints.claim: Defective or off-spec, per the claim decision
kindHints.cancellation: Cancelled after the deposit, before production
kindHints.price_reduction: A lower price for the goods or service
kindHints.discount: A discount given after the sale

wizard.reasonHint: Change it if another reason on the list fits better.
wizard.amountHint: No more than was invoiced less earlier credits; the API checks it again.
wizard.settleToHint: Cash back is a separate refund request.

settlementHints.store_credit: Used against the next order, or refunded later
settlementHints.receivable: Reduces what is still owed on this order

wizard.refundBody: Issue the credit note to store credit first, then request a refund from the payment. The refund is approved separately.
wizard.needAmount: Enter the amount as a number, e.g. 1284 or 1284.00
wizard.needNote: Give details of at least 3 characters
wizard.approvalTitle: Needs approval before it is issued
wizard.approvalBody: The request waits for a Finance Manager other than you; the credit note is numbered and posted once approved.
wizard.sent: Credit note for {order} requested — waiting for approval
wizard.failed: Could not request the credit note

items.title: Trade receivables
items.description: What customers and companies still owe, by due date. A company more than 7 days overdue cannot place credit orders.
items.search: Search by document, customer, company or order
items.writeOffBody: Write off {number} of {party}, {amount} open. The request waits for a Finance Manager.
items.writeOffReason: Reason and the collection effort made

aging.title: Receivables aging
aging.description: What is open by how long it is past due, at the chosen date. The totals come from the books.

allowance.title: Allowance for doubtful accounts
allowance.description: Brings the allowance to a target at a date; only the change is posted (P30). With rates set by age band, no amount is needed.
allowance.targetHint: Leave empty to use the configured rates (if any).
allowance.badAmount: Enter the amount as a number
allowance.confirmTitle: Update the allowance for doubtful accounts
allowance.confirmBody: Set the allowance at {asOf} to {amount}; only the change is posted.
allowance.confirmBodyRates: Set the allowance at {asOf} from the configured rates.

wht.title: Withholding certificates (50 Tawi) from customers
wht.description: Chase the certificates customers owe for tax they withheld until they arrive, then record the number, the date and a copy.
wht.search: Search by customer, company, receipt or certificate number
wht.waiveBody: Stop chasing the certificate for {number}, {amount} withheld. Give a reason that can be checked.

recordForm.title: Record the certificate for {number}
recordForm.copyHint: PDF or image up to 20 MB, kept as a financial record.
recordForm.drop: Drop a file here or choose one
recordForm.wrongType: {name} is not a PDF or an image
recordForm.needDate: Enter the date on the certificate

statements.title: Company monthly statement
statements.description: Every credit-term order up to the chosen month, what was paid and what is still open, for consolidated payment.

dunning.title: Payment reminders
dunning.description: Reminders sent to customers 7 days before the due date, on it, and after it.

party.title: Receivable balance
party.storeCreditNote: Credit from credit notes, used against orders or refunded in cash.

journals.title: Journal {number}
journals.description: Every journal entry. Posted entries cannot be edited; a correction is a reversing entry linked to the original.
journals.caption: Journals of this document
journals.search: Search by entry number, description or source number
journals.noLedgerAccess: You do not have access to the general ledger
journals.trailNote: The source document, the system event, the posting rule, the maker and the checker.
journals.waitingMaker: You made this entry, so another Finance Manager must approve it. It posts when they do.
journals.waitingBody: It posts only when a Finance Manager other than its maker approves it.
journals.rejectedBody: The checker did not approve this entry. Nothing was posted.
journals.autoReverseBody: A reversing entry posts automatically on {date}.

open.title: Open payables
open.description: What Packio owes, net and VAT separately, with the date each becomes payable under the payout policy frozen on its PO.
open.search: Search by vendor, PO or order

purchaseOrders.title: Factory purchase orders
purchaseOrders.description: One per production job released to a factory, at the price and payout policy frozen at release.
purchaseOrders.search: Search by PO, job or order

goodsReceipts.title: Goods receipts
goodsReceipts.description: Recorded from the POD and the reconciled quantity; the factory is paid for the lower of delivered and ordered (, P15).
goodsReceipts.search: Search by GR or PO number

statements.title: Factory billing statements
statements.description: Packio generates the statement from PO and delivery for the factory to confirm; the factory then issues its own tax invoice.
statements.capture: Record a tax invoice for the factory
statements.missingInvoiceBody: Input VAT on this statement cannot be claimed until the factory's valid tax invoice is recorded.

capture.title: Record the tax invoice for {number}
capture.description: For a tax invoice the factory sent by other means. It is the factory's own (its number and its name) and is validated separately.
capture.fromStatement: Filled from the statement; make it match the invoice itself.
capture.needNumber: Enter the tax invoice number and date
capture.saved: Tax invoice recorded — waiting to be checked
capture.drop: Drop a file here or choose one

invoices.title: Tax invoices and vendor bills
invoices.description: Factories' tax invoices against their statements, and other vendors' bills. Input VAT is claimable only with a valid tax invoice.
invoices.search: Search by number, vendor or statement
invoices.checksNote: The seller must be the factory (tax id and branch) and the amounts the statement's.
invoices.validateBody: Validate {number}. Its input VAT of {vat} becomes claimable, and VAT paid while it was missing moves out of the pending account (P17V).
invoices.rejectBody: Reject {number}. The factory sees the reason and sends a correct one.

vendorsPage.title: Vendors
vendorsPage.description: Factories from partner onboarding, and the others — carriers, freelance designers, service vendors.

vendors.title: Vendor master
vendors.description: The withholding form follows the juristic type (individuals PND 3, others PND 53).

banks.title: Payout bank accounts
banks.note: A change is never an edit: the new account waits for two approvers (Finance, then Finance Manager) and a call-back on the number already on record before it is paid into.
banks.factoryNote: Factories propose changes in their portal or through the Partner team; Finance approves and calls back here.

create.title: Add a vendor
create.description: A vendor that is not a factory — a carrier, a designer, a service. Factories come from partner onboarding.
create.name: Registered name
create.juristicHint: Individuals file PND 3; companies and partnerships PND 53.

propose.title: Change the payout account of {vendor}
propose.description: The new account is used after two approvers and a call-back. The number is stored encrypted and only its last 4 digits are shown.
propose.name: Account name
propose.badNumber: Enter a valid account number and name
propose.confirmBody: Change the payout account of {vendor} to the one ending {last4}. Two approvers and a call-back are needed before it is used.

call.title: Record the call-back for the account ending {last4}
call.description: Who called, which number, when, and what came of it.
call.rule: Call the number already on record — never one given in the change request.
call.needCall: Enter the number and the time of the call

bill.title: Record a bill from {vendor}
bill.description: As an expense, cost or asset; input VAT only on a valid tax invoice. Whoever records this vendor's bills cannot change its bank account.
bill.taxInvoiceHint: It carries the vendor's tax id and branch
bill.noVat: Not a tax invoice: no input VAT
bill.needHeader: Enter the bill number and date
bill.needLines: Give every line an account, a description and amounts

payouts.title: Factory and vendor payout runs
payouts.description: Finance builds a run from what is payable and proposes it; a C-Level other than the proposer approves; then the bank file goes out and the bank's result is recorded.

create.title: New payout run
create.description: Collects the payables due by the pay date, per vendor and kind. The run stays a draft until it is proposed.
create.rulesBody: Withholding per line type (hire of work, transport, services), retention held on balances, and vendors without a verified account left out.
create.nothing: Nothing is payable by this date

detail.title: Payout run {run}
detail.waitingBody: A C-Level other than the proposer approves it.
detail.waitingProposer: You proposed this run, so you cannot approve it.
detail.rejectedBody: Its payables wait for the next run.
detail.excludedBody: Their vendors have no verified payout account yet; they stay in the exceptions until one is ready.
detail.proposeBody: Propose run {run}, transferring {cash} in total, for a C-Level's approval.
detail.generateBody: Generate the {format} file of run {run}, transferring {cash} in total. The file is kept as a financial record.
detail.cancelBody: Cancel run {run}; its payables go back to wait for the next run.
detail.proposed: Run proposed — waiting for a C-Level

confirm.title: Record the bank's result for {run}
confirm.description: Enter the bank's result per item, or attach the bank's result file. Paid items get a payment voucher number and are posted.
confirm.confirmLines: Record the result of {run}: {paid} paid, {failed} failed. The postings and 50 Tawi certificates are made straight away.
confirm.confirmFile: Record the result of {run} from {name}. The postings and 50 Tawi certificates are made straight away.
confirm.drop: Drop a file here or choose one

itemDocuments.title: Documents of {pv}
itemDocuments.noWht: Nothing was withheld on this item

exceptionsPage.title: Payout exceptions
exceptionsPage.description: Failed transfers, and items left out for a missing verified bank account.

cashPage.title: Bank and cash
cashPage.description: The books against the bank statements, the matching work, and money whose payer is not known yet.

cash.title: Daily cash position
cash.description: Each bank account's balance in the books beside the last statement balance and what is still unmatched.
cash.clearingNote: Gateway and slip money waiting for its bank line (1131–1133), and receipts whose payer is not known (1140).

lines.title: Bank matching
lines.description: Statement lines not yet explained. Automatic matching uses amount, reference and a date window; the rest needs a person.
lines.search: Search by description, reference or amount

sheet.title: Bank line
sheet.suggestionsNote: By amount, reference and date window. Pick several to split this line.
sheet.noSuggestionsBody: Money in from an unknown payer can be parked as an unidentified receipt.

confirm.matchBody: Match the bank line of {line} to {target} ({amount}). The posting follows the kind of item.
confirm.splitBody: Split the bank line of {line} across {count} items; the parts must add up to the line.
confirm.unidentifiedBody: Park {amount} in unidentified receipts (1140, P29) until the payer is known.
confirm.ignoreTitle: Nothing to post for this line
confirm.ignoreBody: The line of {amount} is not a transaction to post, e.g. a transfer between the company's own accounts already recorded.

import.title: Import bank and gateway files
import.description: Bank statements, and the SCB / 2C2P settlement reports with their fees.
import.statementNote: A file already imported is refused; lines overlapping an earlier file are skipped. New lines are matched automatically at once.
import.fileHint: Columns: date,description,reference,amount,balance (negative amounts are money out)

settlement.title: Gateway settlement report
settlement.description: Posted (P04) when its bank line is found: the net to the bank, the fee to expense, the VAT on the fee to input VAT with the gateway's tax invoice.
settlement.vatHint: As on the fee tax invoice
settlement.rowsHint: One line per payment: gateway reference,gross,fee
settlement.badRows: Every line needs a reference, a gross amount and a fee
settlement.badVat: Enter the VAT on fees as a number
settlement.imported: Imported; {net} THB to the bank, waiting for its bank line

import.drop: Drop a file here or choose one

unidentifiedPage.title: Unidentified receipts
unidentifiedPage.description: Money in that no order claims yet, parked in 1140 until Finance finds the payer (P29).

identifyForm.title: Whose is {amount}?
identifyForm.description: Choose the order group this money pays. It must match the instalment due; its tax invoice / receipt is issued.
identifyForm.searchHint: Order or group code, customer name or phone
identifyForm.confirmBody: Record {amount} as a payment of {group} ({order}). Its tax invoice / receipt is issued and it leaves the clearing account.

accountsPage.title: Company bank accounts
accountsPage.description: Each tied to its own ledger account; only the last 4 digits are shown.

accounts.title: Company bank accounts
accounts.description: A new account is usable after two approvers (Finance, then Finance Manager —).

form.title: Propose a company bank account
form.description: The number is stored encrypted and never shown again.
form.dual: Finance and a Finance Manager (two different people) approve it before use.
form.name: Account name
form.glHint: A bank account 112x not tied to another account
form.needFields: Enter the account name and number

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.description: Every account, its type and normal side, whether it is a control account for a sub-ledger, and the dimensions its lines must carry.

rules.title: Posting rules
rules.description: What each business event posts. A rule changes only by a dated version that another person approves; every posting keeps the version it used.

recurring.title: Recurring journals
recurring.description: Monthly accruals and allocations: approved once, then posted every month on their day.

periods.title: Fiscal periods
periods.description: Open, soft-closed, closed and locked months. A posting dated in a month that no longer takes postings goes to the next open month and keeps its document date.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: What each journal line can be analysed by, and the cost centres Finance keeps.

periodNotice.noneTitle: No open month to post into
periodNotice.noneBody: {what} cannot be posted: no month on or after its date is open. A Finance Manager must open the next month first.
periodNotice.movedBody: {what} will post into {month}. Its document date stays {date} for tax.

lines.costCentreRequired: This account needs a cost centre
lines.controlAccount: A control account takes only postings from its sub-ledger. Choose another account.

editor.title: New manual journal
editor.description: Manual entries are the exception. Save a draft and the system checks the accounts, dimensions and balance. Then submit it: a Finance Manager other than you approves, and only then is it posted with a JV number.
editor.notEditable: This entry can no longer be edited
editor.notEditableBody: Only a draft its maker has not submitted can be changed.
editor.autoReverseHint: For accruals: a reversing entry posts on the date you choose.
editor.linesNote: At least two lines. The system totals debits and credits when you save; an entry that does not balance is not saved.

actions.submitBody: A Finance Manager other than you must approve it, and it posts {amount} on each side. You cannot edit it after this.
actions.discardBody: The draft has never been submitted, so nothing is kept.
actions.reverseBody: A reversing entry of {entry} ({amount}) is drafted for approval. When a Finance Manager approves it, it posts the opposite lines and both entries link to each other.

accounts.title: Chart of accounts
accounts.description: Headings group accounts; only postable accounts take lines. Click an account to see its journals.
accounts.name: Name
accounts.heading: Heading
accounts.changesNote: Each change applies only when a Finance Manager other than the proposer approves it.
accounts.proposeNote: The change is applied only after a Finance Manager other than you approves it.
accounts.reasonShort: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
accounts.deactivateTitle: Only an account with a zero balance
accounts.deactivateBody: An account that still has a balance cannot be deactivated. Move the balance with a journal first.

rules.title: Posting rules
rules.description: One rule per business event. Click a rule to see its template and try it on a sample event.
rules.name: Name
rules.templateNote: Accounts, sides, amounts and tax tags, read from the event's payload.
rules.previewNote: Runs the rule on a sample event without posting anything.
rules.notApplies: The rule's conditions do not match this payload.
rules.proposeNote: The version applies from its date once a Finance Manager other than you approves it. Postings already made keep their version.
rules.reasonShort: Give a reason of at least 3 characters
rules.effectiveHint: Today or later; a rule is never changed back-dated.

recurring.title: Recurring journals
recurring.description: Each definition is approved once by a Finance Manager, then posts every month on its day.
recurring.name: Name
recurring.pauseBody: It stops posting until it is resumed.
recurring.resumeBody: It posts again from its next day of the month.
recurring.endBody: It never posts again. Entries already posted stay.
recurring.newNote: A Finance Manager other than you approves the definition once; after that it posts every month.
recurring.dayHint: 1 to 28, so every month has it
recurring.autoReverseHint: Each posting is reversed on the first day of the next month (accruals).

periods.description: Periods close in order. Only a Finance Manager moves them, and closing or locking also waits for the month's close checklist.

actionBodies.soft-close: Only people allowed to post into a soft-closed month can still post. Everything else goes to the next open month.
actionBodies.reopen: The month takes postings again. A month cannot be reopened once a later month is closed.
actionBodies.close: Nothing posts into this month any more. Earlier months must be closed first. A closed month never reopens.
actionBodies.lock: Locking is final. At the year end the auditor must have signed off first.

dimensionsView.title: Dimensions
dimensionsView.description: Every journal line can carry these. An account can require some of them.
dimensionsView.costCentresNote: Used on expense lines to show where the money went.
dimensionsView.name: Name
dimensionsView.codeHint: Capital letters and digits, e.g. OPS

reports.title: Tax reports
reports.description: Built from the posted journals and certificates, and reconciled to the GL. A report is finalised only when the difference is zero.

calendar.title: Tax calendar
calendar.description: When each return is due, and whether it has been filed.

settings.title: Tax rates & settings
settings.description: Rates change by dated versions that another person approves. The settings are read by every report.

series.title: Document numbering
series.description: One number series per document type. Tax documents are numbered without gaps.

reports.title: {month}
reports.description: Each paper is rebuilt from the books until it is finalised; after that its figures never change.
reports.caption: Tax papers of the month

detail.title: {kind} · {month}

descriptions.sales_tax: Output VAT by tax invoice, credit and debit note. Documents dated in an earlier month are marked late.
descriptions.purchase_tax: Input VAT claimed with a valid tax invoice, by document.
descriptions.pp30: Output VAT less input VAT for the month. Finalising closes the month's VAT into VAT payable.
descriptions.pnd3: Tax withheld from individuals, by 50 Tawi certificate. The export is the attachment for filing.
descriptions.pnd53: Tax withheld from companies, by 50 Tawi certificate. The export is the attachment for filing.
descriptions.wht_issued_register: Every 50 Tawi issued in the month, both forms.
descriptions.wht_received_register: Tax customers withheld from us, and whether their certificate has arrived.

detail.differenceTitle: The report does not agree with the GL
detail.differenceBody: The GL differs from the report by {difference}. Find the entry that was not tagged, or the document posted to the wrong account, then rebuild. It cannot be finalised until the difference is zero.
detail.reconciledBody: The difference is zero, so it can be finalised.
detail.reconciliationNote: What the report says against the movement of its control accounts in the GL.
detail.finaliseBody: It is rebuilt once more and must still agree with the GL. Its figures ({amount}) and its CSV are then fixed for good.
detail.fileBody: The Revenue Department's reference for the return you filed. The calendar item is then done.
detail.filingRefHint: As shown on the e-filing receipt
detail.payBody: {amount} paid to the Revenue Department from a company account. This posts the payment and can be done once.

calendar.title: Tax calendar
calendar.description: Due dates come from the tax calendar setting. An item is done when its return is filed.

settings.ratesNote: A rate changes only by a new version from a date, approved by a Finance Manager other than the person proposing it.
settings.nature: Nature of sale by product type
settings.natureNote: Whether a product is a hire of work or a sale of goods decides when VAT is due and which withholding applies. Snapshotted on every order.
settings.settingsNote: Changed in Settings by their owner, never here.
settings.eTaxNote: Sending documents to the Revenue Department electronically.
settings.eTaxBody: The XML and PDF of every document are generated now. Sending them is switched on after registration with the Revenue Department, in release 2.
settings.proposeNote: It applies from its date once a Finance Manager other than you approves it. It is never back-dated.
settings.reasonShort: Give a reason of at least 3 characters

series.title: Document numbering
series.description: Each series is created once for the entity. Statutory documents must be numbered without gaps.
series.newNote: A document that needs a number is refused until its series exists.
series.gaplessHint: Required for tax invoices, receipts, notes and vouchers
series.missingBody: Documents of these types cannot be numbered yet: {types}.

register.title: Fixed-asset register
register.description: Every asset with its cost, accumulated depreciation and net book value. No barcode tagging.

depreciation.title: Monthly depreciation
depreciation.description: Straight line by month. Check what the month would post, then post it once.

categories.title: Asset categories
categories.description: Each category sets the accounts and the useful life copied onto the assets registered in it.

rollForward.title: Fixed-asset roll-forward
rollForward.description: Cost and depreciation moving through the period, and the register against the GL.

register.title: Fixed-asset register
register.search: Search by asset number or name

new.title: Register an asset
new.description: Its category's accounts and useful life are copied onto it and never change afterwards.

sourceNotes.manual: The cost is posted against the account you choose (for example capital contributed or another asset).
sourceNotes.vendor_bill: The bill already capitalised the cost; this only adds it to the register.

new.name: Name
new.billHint: A recorded bill with a line on the asset account
new.noBills: No bill has an asset line

dispose.title: Sell or write off {asset}?
dispose.body: Its cost {cost} and accumulated depreciation {accumulated} leave the books; any proceeds are recorded and the rest is a gain or loss. Depreciation must be posted up to the month before.
dispose.disposedOnHint: No depreciation is charged in the month of disposal
dispose.proceedsHint: Leave empty if nothing was received

depreciation.title: Depreciation for {month}
depreciation.description: What the month's run would post for each asset. Missed months are caught up; the last month takes the rounding.
depreciation.blockedTitle: This month no longer takes postings
depreciation.blockedBody: Depreciation posts only into an open month. Ask a Finance Manager to reopen it, or choose an open month.
depreciation.doneBody: The run for this month has been posted. Each month is run once.
depreciation.nothingLeft: Nothing left to post for this month
depreciation.confirmBody: One journal of {amount} for {count, plural, one {# asset} other {# assets}}. A month is run once.

categories.title: Asset categories
categories.description: Changing a useful life applies to assets registered afterwards; registered assets keep theirs.
categories.newNote: The accounts are fixed once the category is created.
categories.name: Category
categories.editNote: Names, useful life for new assets, and whether it is in use.
categories.lifeHint: Set by Finance with the auditor
categories.lifeHintEdit: Assets already registered keep their useful life

rollForward.title: Roll-forward by category
rollForward.description: Opening, additions, depreciation, disposals and closing, for the months chosen.
rollForward.reconciliationNote: The register's cost and accumulated depreciation against the balances of their accounts at the end of the period. The difference must be zero.

index.title: Period close
index.description: Each month closes through its checklist: nine steps, then another person's review.
Open a month to work its close.

close.title: Period close
close.description: Each step has an owner and a record; the automatic checks block a step until they pass. A Finance Manager other than the person who submits closes the month.
close.notStarted: This month's close has not started
close.notStartedBody: Starting it creates the nine steps. Nothing changes in the books.
close.remainingTitle: {count, plural, one {# step} other {# steps}} still open
close.remainingBody: Submit for review once steps 1 to 8 are done or waived.
close.inReviewMine: You submitted this close, so another Finance Manager must review it.
close.inReviewBody: Submitted by {name} on {at}. The month is soft-closed while it is reviewed.
close.signedOff: The auditor signed it off on {at}.
close.lockedBody: Nothing can post into this month again. Late items go to the next open month with their document date kept.
close.submitTitle: Submit the close of {month} for review?
close.submitBody: The month is soft-closed: only people allowed to post into a soft-closed month can still post. A Finance Manager other than you reviews it.
close.approveBody: Step 9 is recorded as your review and the month is closed. A closed month never reopens.
close.ownSubmission: You submitted it, so you cannot approve it
close.returnBody: The checklist opens again and the month reopens for postings.
close.lockBody: Locking is final. At the year end the auditor must sign off first.
close.signOffBody: Your sign-off as the auditor is recorded; the year end can then be locked.

statements_imported.title: Bank statements imported and matched
statements_imported.body: Every company account has its statement to the month end, and unmatched lines and gateway settlements are within the allowed number.

slips_and_unidentified.title: Slips reviewed, unidentified receipts explained
slips_and_unidentified.body: No slip is still waiting for Finance; money nobody has claimed is listed.

deliveries_received.title: Deliveries received into AP
deliveries_received.body: Every delivery with a proof of delivery has its goods receipt; factory tax invoices still missing are listed.

receivables_reviewed.title: Receivables and the allowance reviewed
receivables_reviewed.body: Overdue items are reviewed and the allowance for doubtful accounts updated.

rollforwards_reviewed.title: Points liability and retention reviewed
rollforwards_reviewed.body: The roll-forwards of the points liability and the factory retention are reviewed.

accruals_recorded.title: Accruals and manual journals approved
accruals_recorded.body: No manual journal of the month is still waiting for approval.

tax_papers_reconciled.title: Tax papers final and reconciled
tax_papers_reconciled.body: Sales and purchase tax, PP 30, PND 3 and PND 53 are final at a GL difference of zero.

subledgers_reconciled.title: Sub-ledgers agree with the GL
subledgers_reconciled.body: Receivables, payables, retention, store credit and fixed assets equal their control accounts.

review.title: Review and close
review.body: A Finance Manager other than the person who submitted reviews the month and closes it.

task.waiveBody: A Finance Manager accepts the exception with a reason, which is kept with the close.
task.completeAutomatic: The check runs again now; the step is done only if it passes.
task.noteHint: What you looked at and what you found
task.evidenceBody: A file that supports this step: a bank statement, a working paper, a sign-off.
task.drop: Drop a file here or choose one

trialBalance.title: Financial reports
trialBalance.description: From the posted ledger. Each report carries its own check, and every figure opens the lines behind it.

glDetail.title: GL detail
glDetail.description: An account's lines with the running balance; each opens its journal, document and system event.

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet
balanceSheet.description: Assets, liabilities and equity at a date, with the year's profit.

profitAndLoss.title: Profit and loss
profitAndLoss.description: Revenue, cost and margin, pivoted by factory, product type, channel, campaign or cost centre.

cashFlow.title: Cash flow
cashFlow.description: Net profit and each account's movement by its cash-flow class, against the cash accounts.

rollForwards.title: Roll-forwards
rollForwards.description: The points liability and the factory retention, month by month.

reconciliation.title: Sub-ledger reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Each sub-ledger's open amount against its control account in the GL.

trialBalance.title: Trial balance
trialBalance.description: Opening balance, debits, credits and closing balance of every account with movement.

balanceSheet.title: Balance sheet at {date}
balanceSheet.description: The profit of the year is part of equity until it is closed to retained earnings.

profitAndLoss.title: Profit and loss
profitAndLoss.description: Dimensions, not extra accounts: the same lines, grouped by what they carry.
profitAndLoss.empty: No revenue or cost in these months

cashFlow.title: Cash flow (indirect)
cashFlow.description: The net change must equal the movement of the bank and clearing accounts.

rollForwards.pointsNote: Points earned increase it; points redeemed and expired decrease it, at the point value of each entry.
rollForwards.retentionNote: Held from factory balances, released after the retention period.

reconciliation.title: Sub-ledger reconciliation
reconciliation.description: Every difference must be zero before a month can close.
reconciliation.assetsMonth: Fixed assets at the end of

home.title: Auditor
home.description: Read-only access to the books, the registers and the audit trail for the period granted.

exceptions.title: Exception reports
exceptions.description: What an auditor looks at first, month by month.

samples.title: Samples
samples.description: Random or value-stratified samples of a month's records, reproducible from their seed.

pbc.title: PBC pack
pbc.description: The prepared-by-client pack of a month, with its hash.

home.accessUntil: Granted from {from} until {to}. It ends by itself.
home.accessOpen: This auditor access has no end date. Ask the administrator to set one.
home.readOnlyBody: Nothing here changes the books. Your sign-off on a closed month is the only thing you record.
home.registersNote: Every document, journal and paper, each drilling down to its source.

documents.title: Customer documents
documents.body: Tax invoices, receipts, credit and debit notes.

vendorBills.title: Vendor tax invoices and bills
vendorBills.body: Factory tax invoices and other vendors' bills.

journals.title: Journals
journals.body: Every entry with its rule, maker and checker.

whtIssued.title: Tax papers and 50 Tawi issued
whtIssued.body: VAT reports, PP 30, PND 3 / 53 and the WHT register.

whtReceived.title: 50 Tawi received
whtReceived.body: Tax customers withheld, and their certificates.

trialBalance.title: Financial reports
trialBalance.body: Trial balance, GL detail, balance sheet, profit and loss, cash flow.

close.title: Period close
close.body: Each month's checklist and its evidence; sign off here.

auditTrail.title: Audit trail
auditTrail.body: Who did what and when, with its export.

keys.credit_notes_after_period_end: Credit notes after the period end
keys.payouts_without_valid_tax_invoice: Payouts without a valid tax invoice

notes.series_gaps: Numbers missing inside a series that must have no gaps.
notes.outside_business_hours: Manual entries posted outside the business hours set for the auditor's review.
notes.back_dated_documents: Entries dated before the day they were made.
notes.manual_journals_by_user: How many manual entries each maker posted, and their total.
notes.reversals: Every reversing entry posted in the month.
notes.duplicate_vendor_bank_accounts: The same bank account number on more than one vendor (last 4 digits only).
notes.duplicate_slip_references: Slips whose bank reference has been seen before.
notes.credit_notes_after_period_end: Credit notes dated in the following month against this month's documents.
notes.payouts_without_valid_tax_invoice: VAT paid to a factory before its valid tax invoice arrived (input VAT pending).

samples.drawNote: Stratified divides the records into three bands of equal value and samples each in proportion. Keep the seed to draw the same sample again.
samples.seedHint: Leave empty for a new random sample

pbc.title: PBC packs
pbc.description: One file per month: trial balance, GL detail, registers, tax papers, fixed assets, the close checklist and the exceptions. Its SHA-256 is kept.
